nom: DERMA E Vitamin C Whipped Radiance Polish

segments.sensitive: Reports from reviewers with sensitive skin are mixed: several say the polish exfoliates gently without stripping moisture or causing irritation, but one reviewer using a product marketed as safe for sensitive skin developed painful cystic acne bumps on two separate occasions, and another whose skin has grown more sensitive over the years had a breakout the morning after her first use.
segments.combination: One reviewer with mature, combination skin calls it the best exfoliation product she has tried, giving a visible glow without irritation or dryness.
segments.mature: The same reviewer, who describes her skin as mature and mixed, reports this as the best exfoliation product she has tried for it.

concerns.barrier: Two reviewers report the physical granules were too abrasive for their skin: one describes red, dry, irritated welts across her face that took over two weeks to heal after using more product on a third application, and another warns the large granules may cause micro-tears.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report the polish exfoliates without stripping moisture, leaving skin moisturized or hydrated; however, the reviewer who experienced welts also describes her skin as dry and irritated afterward.
concerns.redness: One reviewer notes it does not leave her face very red the way other exfoliants have, though a different reviewer who used more product on her third application experienced red, irritated welts instead.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer developed painful cystic acne bumps on two separate occasions despite the product being marketed as safe for sensitive skin; another had a small breakout around her chin and jaw the morning after her first use but was unsure whether the polish was the cause.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes it leaves no oily residue after use, though this is the only reviewer to comment on oiliness directly.

aspects.libelle: Granules can feel large or rough at first
Fine, smooth whipped texture once worked in
Packaging does not say to rinse off
Hard to fully rinse out, grit lingers

extraits.texte: i love the vitamin c cleansing paste that can also be used as a mask. this does not compare despite ingredients to the contrary. its a big "skip it" from me. granuals are too big and may cause micro-tears, thr amount of vitamin c in this isnt comperable to the paste.

I tried this twice. The first time i had two painful cystic acne bumps on my chin. I thought maybe it wasnt this product & the acne was hormonal. So i decided to give this another try when those cystic acne bumps were better. But guess what… more deep painful cystic acne bumps. This time above my eyebrow. This product aays safe for sensitive skin so im not sure why im having a reaction like this. I really wanted it to work :(

The first couple of times I used this product, I used very little and it left my face looking dull. Not something I expected from a Vitamin C product, but I kept giving it a go because I really like all my other DermaE products. The third time I applied this product to my face I used a little bit more and it DESTROYED my skin. Red, dry, irritated welts appeared all over my face. It's been 2 weeks since then and I'm still trying to get my healthy skin back. I will never put this product on my skin again. And truthfully, I've lost a bit of trust in DermaE. I should have known better by now abrasive it felt, but there are so many positive reviews on this product.

extraits.titre: A little rough but worth the results
extraits.texte: Face feels exfoliated and fresh. My the skin under my eyebrows can get dry and flakey and this has helped manage that problem. The initial texture is a bit rough but feels good after a few seconds. A little doesn't really go a long way before the exfoliant disintegrates but its not terrible. The scent is amazing!

My skin has become more sensitive over the last few years so I usually stay away from exfoliants, but the whipped polish effectively exfoliated my skin and works nicely to provide that extra "deep cleaning" without feeling harsh/abrasive or drying. I had a little breakout around my chin & jaw the next morning, but will need to try the polish a few more times to see if it had to do with the actual product or it was just my skin's initial shock/reaction to an exfoliant.

It feels like a soft but fine scrub. It's not too coarse, fells like fine sand. It makes my skin super clean, the scent is very nice and the best part, you can see your skin glow without irritation or dryness. I have mature mixed skin and it's the best exfoliation product I have tried!
Did a great job exfoliating without stripping away all of the moisture. I have sensitive skin and it worked well.
